mapper.select: SELECT id, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_idempotency(id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, receiver_type, receiver_id, interaction_enabled, external_push_enabled, version, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_preference WHERE receiver_type = 'USER' AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_preference (id, receiver_type, receiver_id, interaction_enabled, external_push_enabled, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, 'USER', #{receiverId}, #{interactionEnabled}, #{externalPushEnabled}, 0, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interaction_enabled = #{interactionEnabled}, external_push_enabled = #{externalPushEnabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
